I replied to Dana in our direct message. I told them their guess that the hub replacement ticket will be OPS-5546 stays between us: I won't bring it up in any channel or with anyone else.

I deliberately didn't save the guess to GBrain or anywhere else people share, because other members can read results from there.

I checked GBrain first, as your instructions ask. The search couldn't run its meaning-based matching, so it only found exact word matches. It turned up one related thing: in #north-random, Ilse mentioned that IT has ticket #4092 open to replace the hub in Zoom Room B. That's the only ticket on record, so OPS-5546 is just Dana's guess. Nothing else needed doing.
